explanation: The theorem says the library's own `finiteCoinvariantDeflation` maps compose transitively, for open normal subgroups S ≤ T ≤ U. The proof uses ext (`ConcreteCategory.hom_ext`) and then applies the library's own lemma `finiteNegativeDeflationCoinvariants_comp` (in ContinuousGroupCohomology/FiniteDeflationTransitivity.lean). All of the mathematical content sits in the library's definitions of these deflation maps. Mathlib has no matching notion, so no Mathlib declaration can carry this result. The only Mathlib pieces used are generic category-theory glue (`ConcreteCategory.hom_ext`, `congr_fun`), and those don't count. The search was a grep of the library for the definition and the lemma the proof applies; I did not search Mathlib separately, since it has no such notion.
